description: Retrieve related CSAM 2024 sections/content using its source-evidenced knowledge graph. Start with a procedure number, a chunk_id from sacs_search_csam, a returned node_id, or short heading/code/glossary keywords (exactly one selector). Defaults to explicit references in both directions. Choose relations contains/in_procedure for hierarchy, defines/mentions for code or glossary connections, within_range for numeric code membership, or next for source adjacency; depth 1–2. Every result explains its evidence path and returns at most one cited text/Markdown chunk; representative content is partial. Query node_id=csam:2024:manual with relations=[contains] to browse structure. Use include_content=false for topology-only pages. No database/model calls or paid entitlement required.
name: sacs_get_csam_related

description: Search California School Accounting Manual (CSAM 2024) by keywords and topic, procedure number or a returned chunk_id. Use chunk_id with direction=previous or next and limit (1–10) to read adjacent source chunks within the same procedure; navigation.continuation supplies the next request. Results include extracted text plus Markdown with conservative code-definition/journal tables, topic path, procedure revision, printed/PDF page and a CDE PDF citation. All non-stopword keywords must match; topic filters heading words. Use short accounting terms rather than a long question. Read citations for surrounding tables/context; later correspondence is excluded. No login or model-provider key required.
name: sacs_search_csam
